baseUrl.title: Base URL Configuration
baseUrl.description: Configure a custom base URL for all model requests. This allows you to route requests through your own proxy or server.
baseUrl.hint: Leave empty to use the default Chorus proxy. When set, all model requests will be sent directly to this URL without any path modifications.
